layout.footer: You received this email because of your CauseDeck account.
layout.mandatory: This is a required account email and cannot be turned off.

magicLink.subject: Your CauseDeck sign-in link
magicLink.heading: Sign in to CauseDeck
magicLink.body: Use the button below to sign in. The link expires in {minutes} minutes and works once.
magicLink.fallback: If the button does not work, open this link:
magicLink.ignore: If you did not ask to sign in, you can ignore this email.

invitation.subject: You are invited to a CauseDeck workspace
invitation.heading: You are invited to a workspace
invitation.body: A colleague invited you to join their CauseDeck workspace. The invitation expires in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
invitation.fallback: If the button does not work, open this link:
invitation.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

securityAlert.subject: Security alert: {title}
securityAlert.preview: Security activity on your CauseDeck account
securityAlert.intro: We noticed security activity on your CauseDeck account.
securityAlert.help: If this was not you, sign out of other sessions and contact your workspace owner.

dailyDigest.subject: Your CauseDeck daily digest
dailyDigest.heading: Today in your workspace
dailyDigest.summary: {count, plural, one {# update} other {# updates}} since your last digest.
dailyDigest.empty: Nothing new since your last digest.

endOfDayDigest.subject: What CauseDeck did today
endOfDayDigest.preview: A count of what CauseDeck did and what waits for you
endOfDayDigest.heading: What CauseDeck did today
endOfDayDigest.applied: {count, plural, =0 {CauseDeck applied nothing on its own today.} one {CauseDeck applied # change on its own today. You can undo it for 7 days.} other {CauseDeck applied # changes on its own today. You can undo them for 7 days.}}
endOfDayDigest.pending: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing is waiting for your confirmation.} one {# proposal is waiting for your confirmation.} other {# proposals are waiting for your confirmation.}}
endOfDayDigest.note: This summary only opens the app. It never changes anything and it is not sent to anyone else.

billingNotice.subject: Billing: {title}
billingNotice.preview: A billing update for your workspace

notice.subject: {title}
notice.preview: An update from your CauseDeck workspace

card.title: Push notifications
card.body: Get a nudge before your hearings. You can change this any time.
card.enabled: Push notifications are on for this browser.
card.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings to turn them on.
card.error: Could not turn on push notifications. Try again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.announce: {count, plural, one {# new notification} other {# new notifications}}

preferences.title: Notification preferences
preferences.description: Choose how CauseDeck tells you about activity in {workspace}.
preferences.linkHint: Choose channels, the daily digest and quiet hours.
preferences.matrixCaption: Channels for each kind of notification

workspaceInvite.label: Workspace invitations
workspaceInvite.description: When someone invites you to a workspace.

securityAlert.label: Security alerts
securityAlert.description: Sign-ins and changes to your account.

proposalNew.label: New proposals
proposalNew.description: When CauseDeck prepares something for you to review.

courtBoard.label: Court-day alerts
courtBoard.description: When an item of yours is a few items away, now being heard, or the court rises or passes it over.

judgmentAlert.label: Relevant judgments
judgmentAlert.description: When a new judgment cites a statute section confirmed on one of your matters.

statusNextDate.label: Next hearing date
statusNextDate.description: When a watched case shows a new next hearing date.

statusOrder.label: New orders
statusOrder.description: When a watched case lists a new order.

statusStage.label: Stage changes
statusStage.description: When a watched case moves to a new stage.

notices.label: Court notices
notices.description: When the court or Bar Council publishes a notice for a forum you use.

benchChange.label: Bench changes
benchChange.description: When a court notice about a leave, special bench or roster change affects a matter you have listed.

digestDaily.label: Daily digest
digestDaily.description: One email at 6:30 pm with the day's updates.

digestEndOfDay.label: What CauseDeck did today
digestEndOfDay.description: One summary each evening: what CauseDeck applied and what waits for you.

preferences.mandatory: Security alerts are always sent in the app and by email so you never miss a sign-in or account change.

digest.label: Email digest
digest.hint: Instant sends each email as it happens. Daily gathers them into one email at 6:30 pm. Off sends only required emails.

courtHours.label: Do not push during court hours
courtHours.hint: No push notifications from 10:30 am to 5:00 pm in your workspace time zone.

lockScreen.label: Show details on lock screen
lockScreen.hint: When off, push notifications show only a general title, never matter or party names.

preferences.error: Could not save your change. Try again.
preferences.empty: No notification settings are available for this workspace yet.
